Erin (Design): dropped a compact toolbar mock for the trace viewer. trying to balance density + discoverability. screenshot: https://imgur.com/compact-mock Jonah - Eng: nice. two implementation constraints: 1) touch targets >= 44px on mobile; 2) scrubber events are hot — we should avoid too many DOM updates when dragging. Priya PM: Support asks: when users export we should give an option to export 'selection' (current time window) vs 'full trace'. often they only need the 10s failure window. Can we surface that? Erin (Design): proposal: primary export action = small export icon. click opens a compact menu with: "Download snapshot (.har)" and a secondary "Download selection (.har)". add a tiny chevron to expose .json option. Sam QA: QA note: please include the trace permalink in the exported metadata (so uploaded HARs can be correlated). Also include the correlation id and timestamp of selection start/end. Maya Support: +1. Also please include a plain-text stack copy option in the export menu: "Copy stack as text". Support copies frames into tickets a lot. a11y-bot: Accessibility reminders: menu must be keyboard-trappable (Enter to open, Arrow keys to navigate, Esc to close). Use role="menu"/role="menuitem" and aria-haspopup="true" on the toggle. Ensure color contrast for toolbar icons >= 4.5:1 on light. Jonah - Eng: on copy stack: impl suggestion: build two formats — plain text and markdown (with file:line links). example payloads in clipboard: ``` Plain text: Trace: 9a7f1c2b Permalink: https://redwood/trace/9a7f1c2b Stack: com.redwood.Service.process(Service.java:128) com.redwood.Router.route(Router.java:42) Markdown: - `com.redwood.Service.process` — Service.java:128 ([open](https://redwood/source/blob/...#L128)) ``` Priya PM: should the default copy include permalink + trace id? support wants single-paste context. Maya Support: default should be: full-trace-id + permalink + selected time-range (if any). one-line header is ideal so they can paste into ticket subject if needed. Erin (Design): UX question: do we show "Copy stack" inline next to folded stack traces or keep it in export menu? inline is faster but creates visual clutter. Thoughts? Sam QA: inline copy next to each collapsed stack is super useful for triage. make it a tiny link-style button (not primary). ensure it has aria-label="Copy stack as text for frame X". a11y-bot: also add aria-live region for copy confirmation. e.g., "
Copied stack to clipboard
" so screen readers announce success. Jonah - Eng: keyboard shortcuts request: suggested defaults — Space toggles playback, Left/Right arrow scrub 100ms, Shift+Left/Right scrub 1s, Home/End jump to start/end. We'll expose these in a tooltip and in the keyboard shortcuts docs. Erin (Design): careful with Space — if a focused button has default Space semantics we need to prevent conflicts. maybe use K to toggle playback (K like video players) and Space still works when scrubber not focused. Priya PM: K works for power users; but discoverability suffers. show tooltip on hover and list on the settings modal. also add a small keyboard hint (e.g., "K") in the tooltip for the play button. Maya Support: can we add an on-screen timestamp readout that copies with ctrl/cmd+C when focused? sometimes they want the exact broken frame timestamp quickly. Jonah - Eng: doable. we'll make the timestamp a focusable element with `tabindex=0` and a copy action. add aria-label="Copy timestamp". Erin (Design): copy button labels: decide between "Download trace (.har)" vs "Save snapshot (.har)" vs "Export trace (.har)". My vote: "Download trace snapshot (.har)" — explicit and friendly. Priya PM: prefer "Export trace (.har)" — consistent with other consoles. but ok with Erin's longer label if it's clearer. Sam QA: technical: server can produce har or trace.json. UI should show primary HAR and an inline small chevron for .json like: "Download trace snapshot (.har) ▾" which opens a tiny sub-menu with JSON. a11y-bot: also ensure export menu announces file types with readable names ("HAR format, contains network and timing data"). Erin (Design): mobile behavior: collapse toolbar to icons only. export opens full-screen bottom sheet with selection toggles (Full / Selection) and file type picker. we avoid hover-dependent interactions. Jonah - Eng: performance: for long traces, timeline ticks must be virtualized. scrubber should map to an index, not re-render thousands of tick DOM nodes. Maya Support: one more ask — when copying correlation id, allow copy options: short id vs full id vs id + permalink. maybe a small chevron on the pill? Erin (Design): proposal for correlation pill: default pill shows short id, on hover/focus a mini-menu gives: Copy short, Copy full, Copy full + permalink. on mobile the pill opens full options panel. Priya PM: decision summary: 1) export menu exposes Full vs Selection and HAR primary with JSON as secondary; 2) include permalink + trace id in exported metadata; 3) add inline "Copy stack" next to collapsed stack frames + export menu copy options; 4) keyboard shortcuts: K toggle, arrows scrub, Shift for larger steps; 5) correlation pill exposes copy variants; 6) mobile uses bottom sheet for export. any objections? Jonah - Eng: no objections. will raise perf PR for virtualization.
